messages:
maggie (product): Quick sync: customer-driven asks piled up from ACME & Beacon. We need to lock launch gates and dependency owners by EOD Friday. Main asks: per-tenant prewarm, stronger latency SLOs for paid tier, and audit-ready telemetry.

leo (eng-runtime): For paid tier latency SLOs we need explicit workload profiles. Can someone paste typical prompt size / seq distribution for those customers? Without that our p95 numbers are meaningless.

maggie (product): ACME: ~2k tokens median, long-tail to 6k; Beacon: ~600 tokens median. I'll DM detailed examples.

derek (infra): Good to know. Infrastructure question: per-tenant prewarm has measurable cost. We can make it an opt-in addon with a 30d reservation for reserved capacity. Need sign-off from finance on pricing before infra commits.

sarah (security): On telemetry: we can produce audit-ready logs, but SOC2 dataflow review for per-tenant telemetry takes ~3 weeks. If customers require ephemeral logs we need to define retention toggles now.

vijay (eng-platform): I'll prepare a dependency contract template with: owners, SLA (latency/cost), prewarm knobs (on/off + concurrency cap), rollout gating criteria, and rollback trigger matrix. Will PR by Thu.

maggie (product): Launch gating proposal: 1) perf envelope validated by runtime for each customer profile; 2) infra commit for capacities + pricing; 3) security signoff on telemetry & KMS; 4) customer acceptance test pass. If any gating item is partial we go to soft-launch (limited traffic).

leo (eng-runtime): Runtime work items: prefix-cache for ACME (2w), KV eviction tuning (1w), and quantized small-model variant for graceful degrade (1w). Can put two engineers on prefix-cache.

derek (infra): Infra work items: capacity reservation plan (tiers), prewarm opt-in plumbing, and cost model. Blocker: need prewarm API final shape.

maggie (product): Decision: freeze prewarm API to on/off + target_concurrency + reservation_id. No runtime/config hot paths for GA. Everyone ok?

leo (eng-runtime): Ok from runtime. Keeps integration simple.

sarah (security): Ok. Smaller surface helps audit. Add retention toggles to telemetry contract.

vijay (eng-platform): Will include a short runbook snippet in the draft contract:

```
# soft-launch rollback runbook excerpt
if p95 latency > target for 5m and error_rate > 1%:
  - route new traffic to alpha lane
  - enable degrade_to: "small-model-quant"
  - notify oncall-runtime & infra
  - escalate to product for customer comms
```

infra-bot: infra-bot created ticket INF-7802 for capacity-reservation plan assigned to derek.

maggie (product): Action items: leo deliver perf checklist per customer by Wed; derek post capacity+pricing by Thu; sarah start telemetry SOC2 review & flag any blockers; vijay open dep-contract PR Thu morning. Wed 11am sync to review drafts. Call out scheduling conflicts now.

derek (infra): FYI finance wants an estimated committed spend number before Thu. I'll pull a rough estimate today and update the ticket.

leo (eng-runtime): If finance wants numbers I'll run a quick sim based on med/peak qps assumptions. Need those qps targets from product.

maggie (product): I'll add qps targets to the ACME/Beacon sheets and share link in the channel. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
